finding: Accuracy barely moved (0.9007 vs 0.907) but ECE is 2.4x worse (0.0441 vs 0.018). The leakage was not inflating ACCURACY — it was concealing MISCALIBRATION. Confidence looked trustworthy because it was measured on memorised phrases. Every confidence-gated behaviour (the 0.70 fire threshold, the 0.80 confirm gate, semantic rescue) was tuned against that illusion, which is exactly what B2/B3 fix.
